questions: Did your balance and coordination problems begin suddenly, over minutes to hours?
Did they begin within the past few days?
Have the symptoms been steadily worsening since they began?
Do the episodes come and go with periods of normal coordination between them?
Are the episodes triggered by standing, walking, or changes in head position?
Have you had a severe or unusual headache with these symptoms?
Have you had double vision, slurred speech, difficulty swallowing, or abnormal eye movements?
Have you had weakness or numbness on one side of your body?
Have you had loss of consciousness, a seizure, or marked confusion?
Have you had fever or a recent infection before the coordination problems began?
Have you recently had vomiting or diarrhea?
Have you started, stopped, or had a dose increase of any medication before these symptoms began?
Have you taken phenytoin, lithium, metronidazole, chemotherapy, sedatives, or other drugs known to affect coordination?
Do you drink alcohol heavily or daily?
Did the symptoms begin after an injury to your head or neck?
Have you had recent exposure to toxins, solvents, or heavy metals?
Have you noticed numbness, tingling, or reduced sensation in your feet or hands?
Have you had hearing loss, ringing in the ears, or severe vertigo?
Have you had bladder problems, erectile dysfunction, fainting on standing, or abnormal sweating?
Have you experienced memory loss, personality change, stiffness, or slowed movements?
Did these problems begin before age 25?
Has anyone in your family had unexplained balance problems, tremor, or a similar neurological illness?
Have you had cancer, HIV, an immune-system disorder, or an organ transplant?
Have you had unexplained weight loss or night sweats?
Have you had thyroid disease, vitamin B12 deficiency, or gluten sensitivity?
Have you recently received an immune-stimulating treatment or vaccination?
Have you had recurrent attacks of migraine or episodic neurological symptoms in the past?
Have you had difficulty seeing in dim light or progressive loss of vision?
Have you had muscle weakness, muscle wasting, or difficulty releasing your grip?
Has a brain or spinal scan previously shown an abnormality?
